launch_method: Fixed user-private OwnerTrial.command opened in Terminal; user completes sudo locally; no AppleScript administrator relay.
baseline_device_calls: Byte-identical owner_iokit.c and owner_core.c from04; count, arguments and order unchanged.
new_guard: Before frame open/ACK/provider: current console UID501, both audit UIDs501, successful audit/Security reads, same nonzero GUI Security/audit session, TTY and nonremote required.
supervision: open exit0 is launch request only. Actual kernel helper PID/UID/birth/path+ACK and same nonce/result SHA remain required; separate bounded command completion marker.
prerequisite: All FX3 volumes manually ejected; camera on, cable connected, same port, MSC; one cached preflight after explicit approval.
privilege_and_privacy: One reviewed sudo bootstrap installs exact SHA executable into root-private directory. No privacy setting edit/reset or automatic consent. sudo verification stays in Terminal; do not send password. macOS may display removable-volume consent; any additional consent choice is left to the user.
failure_policy: Exclusive user claim, command-entry directory and root-entry lease; consumed on staged attempt, no reuse or auto retry. Pending calls keep UNKNOWN, no kill/reset/config fallback. Independent post-return driver cache observation required.
forbidden: Sony authentication, service commands, mode entry or payload/module upload
Automatic eject/unmount, driver installation or persistent service/sudoers changes
TCC database access/reset, Full Disk Access grant, audit setters or sandbox exceptions
Reuse camera01-04 or completed host-audit01 authorization
acceptance: This diagnostic tests only ownership/interface metadata/return with independent cached driver association; target MAIN recording, backup/restore/rescue remain unproven.
